title: Approximate tangent space transfers across zero-density differences: T_x N = P ⇒ T_x C = P (Simon Remark 3.1.5(2))
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^{n+ℓ} (= Amb n ℓ), x ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ} and P a linear subspace of ℝ^{n+ℓ}. Let C, N, D ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} with D Borel, D ⊆ C, D ⊆ N, Hⁿ(C) < ∞ and Hⁿ(N) < ∞. Suppose (ρⁿ)⁻¹·Hⁿ.real((C ∖ D) ∩ B_ρ(x)) → 0 and (ρⁿ)⁻¹·Hⁿ.real((N ∖ D) ∩ B_ρ(x)) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0 (B_ρ(x) closed ball, Hⁿ.real := (Hⁿ ·).toReal), and P is the approximate tangent space of N at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.4 (Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x P: finrank P = n and ∫_{η_{x,r}(N)} f dHⁿ → ∫_P f dHⁿ as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^{n+ℓ}, ℝ)). Then P is the approximate tangent space of C at x (Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C x P).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (C N D : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (x : Amb n ℓ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), MeasurableSet D → D ⊆ C → D ⊆ N → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) C < ∞ → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) N < ∞ → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).real ((C \ D) ∩ closedBall x ρ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).real ((N \ D) ∩ closedBall x ρ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x P → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C x P
